label: Selected grounding composes along CONCRETE_6 edges starting at an actual root
paraphrase: Open analyst premise. If r is an actual concrete root, x is actual concrete, and the selected actual concrete ground edges r to y and y to x hold at w, then the edge r to x holds in the same relation at w. Both starting points of the two edges are actual concreta. No assumption is made for composition beginning at a nonroot, for absent endpoints, or for other worlds.
